title: Endangerment Finding Repeal—Legal Challenges and State Climate Authority May Alter Intended Outcomes
content: In 2009, the US Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) determined that greenhouse gases (GHG) jeopardize public health and welfare. This “Endangerment Finding” was the legal foundation for all subsequent rules proposed to regulate GHG emissions at the federal and state level.
author: David W. South
